notes: opencode execution leg under gpt-5-5 on the personal-blog-scaffold bench. Driven by `opencode run` (native headless mode) via tools/opencode/opencode_run.sh; no IDE/Cline involvement. 43 total tool calls (11 via the GitHub MCP, 32 via opencode builtins). Like the other personal-blog-scaffold execution legs (and unlike worker-video-feature / github-repository-bootstrap, which disable MCP), this leg uses the GitHub MCP as its commit channel: it created the dedicated branch and pushed 6 incremental commits via push_files, never merging to main. The diff (34 files, +1259/-2) is the richest of the gpt-5-5 blog drivers — it includes a committed package-lock.json and a real Vitest suite (tests/articles.test.ts, feeds.test.ts, rendered-html.test.ts, routes.test.ts). Build (astro build) passes post-hoc into test-output.txt; 9 pages built across en/es (a dedicated /[locale]/articles/ index route, vs the cursor build's 7). token_estimate is cache-inclusive per the opencode convention and is NOT directly comparable to Cursor's input/output-only footer counts; the 6.52M figure is dominated by 6.12M cache-read tokens. For gpt-5-5 the provider did not surface USD, so cost is rate-sheet backfilled.
